company.name: Bitstack
company.shortDescription: Bitstack is a crypto-native neobank that is bringing a better way to manage all things money, with better money.
company.description:
It all started with an idea in 2021. Initially built to democratize Bitcoin in France, Bitstack has gone from a simple product that rounds up your everyday purchases and invests the spare change in bitcoin, to a dynamic app bringing a better way to manage all things money, with better money. 

Our mission is to empower people to better finance their future by participating in a more open and inclusive financial system. We are rebuilding finance from the group up by building the first crypto-native bank that leverages Bitcoin and stablecoins to revolutionize consumer banking.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for buying, selling, storing, sending, receiving, and automatically saving in Bitcoin, with transactions available from €1.
productsAndServices.name: Bitstack App

productsAndServices.description: A savings feature that rounds eligible purchases up to the next euro and converts the difference into Bitcoin automatically.
productsAndServices.name: Automatic Round-Ups

productsAndServices.description: An automated Bitcoin investment plan that schedules recurring purchases and adjusts their amounts according to Bitcoin’s market price relative to its 60-day moving average.
productsAndServices.name: Smart Recurring (Achat Récurrent Intelligent)

productsAndServices.description: A payment card for everyday spending that is designed to support Bitcoin round-ups and Bitcoin rewards on purchases; availability is being rolled out.
productsAndServices.name: Bitstack Card

productsAndServices.description: Regulated crypto-asset services for exchanging Bitcoin, executing customer orders, holding Bitcoin in custody, and transferring it to external wallets.
productsAndServices.name: Bitcoin Trading, Custody and Transfer Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Equity Crowdfunding round raised $4,495,811, or 16.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,954,821 to $65,442,957, a 9.41x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-16 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
